name: Shoushin no Messiah
source:
"A robot designed to warm women's hearts, heal them, and make them happy..." 

With this pamphlet-like introduction, he arrived at my doorstep.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21944]Freem[/url]]
translation:
“一个旨在温暖女性心灵、治愈她们、让她们幸福的机器人……” 

带着这本小册子般的介绍，他来到了我家门口。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21944]Freem[/url]]
